prediction_question: At the instant IBAMA issues a new environmental infraction notice (auto de infracao, lavratura) against an entity, will the same entity (CPF/CNPJ) receive another IBAMA infraction notice within the following 12 months?
prediction_time: The prediction instant is the lavratura instant: DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO of the current auto de infracao, the earliest documented moment the enforcement act exists (recorded by the electronic AI-e form since 2019-10-08, and by the launch date DT_LANCAMENTO for the pre-2019 analogue SICAFI series). Features are restricted to (a) the current auto's issuance-time attributes (infraction type/code, proposed sanction TIPO_AUTO, initial value VAL_AUTO_INFRACAO, gravity classification GRAVIDADE_INFRACAO, conduct MOTIVACAO_CONDUTA, UF/municipio, bioma, action motivation TIPO_ACAO, operation name) and (b) the entity's PRIOR autos only (DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO strictly earlier than the instant). Post-instant process events defined by IN Ibama 19/2023 (ciencia of the auto, defense, julgamento in first instance ~30 days from file receipt, appeal ~20 days, second instance, Cadin inclusion) are label-window events of the current auto's lifecycle, never features. LIMITATION, recorded: the daily export is current-vintage only (no publisher archive of past exports); prior-history features are therefore current-vintage rows with per-row DT_ULT_ALTERACAO / TP_ULT_ALTERACAO / JUSTIFICATIVA_ALTERACAO available to quantify how much history was revised. The 12-month target window follows the prediction instant entirely. MEASURED 2026-11-04 (worker probe ibama-probe-002, full current vintage, 705,667 rows): DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO is non-empty on 705,667/705,667 rows (91,632 date-only 'YYYY-MM-DD' concentrated in the pre-AIe eras + 614,035 full 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'), so the lavratura instant is directly the published column on every row; the DT_LANCAMENTO fallback was never needed (0 rows fell back; DT_LANCAMENTO itself is empty on 479 rows); 0 unparseable dates. Every row carries the same export stamp 2026-11-03 01:28:15, i.e. the zip is one full daily re-export (current-vintage only). Revision churn measured from DT_ULT_ALTERACAO: rows altered within the 12 months before the export stamp are <=1.2% for every lavratura year <=2024, 30.5% for 2025 and 100% for 2026 - the current-vintage limitation is concentrated in the most recent ~18 months, matching the censoring design; the evaluation contract must state the retrospective/current-vintage as-of policy (datasus-sinasc precedent). Timestamps carry no timezone; treated as publisher-local (America/Sao_Paulo).
target_definition: Binary label: exists another auto de infracao in the same published table with identical CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR and DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO in (T, T+365 days], where T is the current auto's lavratura instant. Label source columns: CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR and DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO; both excludable from shipped features (entity keys shipped hashed). Censoring: right-censoring at the last observed lavratura date in the extract; entities leaving enforcement attention are treated as no re-autuacao observed (this is a re-AUTUACAO task, not a reoffense task - enforcement effort confound stated in the task card, not hidden). MEASURED 2026-11-04: label computed on raw CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR equality - entities are stored in canonical punctuated form (672,780/672,793 non-empty rows carry ./- punctuation; digit-normalized length is 11 for 453,978 cpf rows (64.4%) and 14 for 218,797 cnpj rows (31.0%); 32,874 missing (4.7%, concentrated pre-1995), 18 other) - so construction MUST normalize to bare digits before joining and hashing; the probe's raw-equality rates are the measured baseline. Publisher cross-check of the entity classification: TP_PESSOA_INFRATOR matches the digit-based split exactly (2023: PF 9,929 = cpf11 9,929; PJ 6,376 = cnpj14 6,376). Right-censoring measured at the extract's max lavratura 2026-10-30: 2,347 rows of 2025 and all 10,562 rows of 2026 fall inside the unobserved 365-day window. Status-mix design input: 2023 carries Lavrado 16,250 (99.0%), Cancelado 146, Excluido 10, Substituido por outro 3; SIT_CANCELADO='S' is ~1%/yr - construction must state which side of the population these rows fall on.

licence_note: Class A reasoning, recorded: IBAMA is federal Executive branch (autarquia federal); the dataset is published on the publisher's official open-data platform and is itself marked 'Outra (Aberta)' (Other/Open) at dataset level. The governing instrument is Decreto 8.777/2016 as amended by Decreto 9.903/2019, which defines federal open data as published under an open licence allowing free use with attribution of source only, and authorizes free use of Union-held databases. No dataset-specific restrictive terms exist on the dataset page (read in full in the supported browser). Redistributing derived rows therefore requires crediting IBAMA as the source. Personal-data design note (LGPD): rows carry NOME_INFRATOR and CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR of individuals; these are public enforcement acts published openly by the authority, but the shipped dataset must hash entity keys (or restrict to CNPJ legal entities) and must not ship raw individual identifiers as features; to be settled at construction.
license_evidence: Decreto 8.777/2016, art. 2, III (DOU 2016-05-12, via in.gov.br, read 2026-10-30): 'dados abertos - dados acessiveis ao publico, representados em meio digital, estruturados em formato aberto, processaveis por maquina, referenciados na internet e disponibilizados sob licenca aberta que permita sua livre utilizacao, consumo ou cruzamento, limitando-se a creditar a autoria ou a fonte.'

split_strategy: Entity-instant panel over all autos in the current vintage (1977-09-03..2026-10-30 measured): one row per (entity, auto) with prior-history features strictly earlier than the lavratura instant. MEASURED 2026-11-04 on the full current table (ibama-probe-002, zip sha256 4db188142b03a598d839f5331d3c148aeb7718fd6a657f324d8e98b959621771, 123,308,204 bytes, export stamp 2026-11-03 01:28:15; 705,667 rows, 0 duplicate SEQ in this export - the publisher's multiplicity warning did not materialize in the 2026-11-03 csv): windows on lavratura year, valid-entity, right-censored at 2025-10-30 23:59:59 - train 2005-2015: 251,614 rows / 44,805 positives (17.81%), 23,430 distinct positive entities, 6,149 distinct SEQ_ACAO_FISCALIZATORIA, 132 distinct (year,month), 27 UFs; eval 2016-2019: 65,725 / 18,216 (27.72%), 8,573 / 13,624 / 48 / 27; holdout 2022-2025: 52,741 / 14,995 (28.43%), 7,241 / 14,800 / 46 / 27. Context buckets: pre-2005 271,385 / 36,122 (13.31%, 16,340 distinct positive entities, SEQ_ACAO empty in this era); gap 2020-2021 excluded (18,419 / 4,861, 26.39%); 2026 excluded (10,562 rows, all censored). First-time vs repeat measured per year (2023: first-time 8,449 n / 1,524 pos = 18.0%; repeat 7,856 n / 3,878 pos = 49.4%); distinct entities overall 439,781 with autos-per-entity bins 1:335,785, 2:62,530, 3-5:32,272, 6-20:8,613, 21+:581. Base-rate drift across windows (17.8% -> 27.7% -> 28.4%) is a measured phenomenon property (era + enforcement regime). Clustering for the gate's enough_clustered_positives check: positives cluster by entity (serial infringers) and by fiscalizacao action (SEQ_ACAO_FISCALIZATORIA) - thousands of distinct clusters per window, so the camara-style year-cluster failure cannot occur; entity (or entity+action) is the natural event key.

review: Five contracts, reconciled against written evidence (worker probe ibama-probe-002, full current vintage, 2026-11-04): (1) Redistribution SUPPORTED - class A per Decreto 8.777/2016 art. 2 III / art. 4 as amended by Decreto 9.903/2019 (permissive instruments quoted 2026-10-30 in licence_note and license_evidence), dataset marked 'Outra (Aberta)'; LGPD duty recorded: entity keys shipped hashed, NOME_INFRATOR never shipped. (2) Prediction timing SUPPORTED with documented vintage limitation - instant = lavratura, present on 705,667/705,667 rows (measured; DT_LANCAMENTO fallback unused); the zip is one full daily re-export (single stamp on all rows) and no publisher archive of past vintages exists, so the as-of policy is retrospective/current-vintage - revision churn measured at <=1.2%/yr for lavratura years <=2024, 30.5% for 2025, 100% for 2026, and the evaluation contract must state it (datasus-sinasc precedent); the 12-month target window lies strictly after the instant by construction. (3) Target SUPPORTED - mechanical same-table label (entity + strictly-later lavratura within 365 days), label source columns excludable, entity coverage 95.3% measured and cross-validated against the publisher's TP_PESSOA_INFRATOR column (exact match), right-censoring measured (2,347 rows of 2025, all 10,562 of 2026 inside the unobserved window); this is a re-AUTUACAO task under enforcement attention, not a reoffense claim - stated in the task card, not hidden. (4) Split capacity SUPPORTED, measured on the full table - every window carries both classes with thousands of independent clusters (train 44,805 positives over 23,430 entities / 6,149 actions; eval 18,216 over 8,573 / 13,624; holdout 14,995 over 7,241 / 14,800), so the clustered-positives gate cannot fail camara-style; base-rate drift 17.8% -> 27.7% -> 28.4% recorded as a phenomenon property. (5) Not a mirror SUPPORTED - differentiated novelty verdict recorded 2026-10-30 (mechanical check; prior art = causal survival analyses of flora subsets 2000-2010, no ML-ready benchmark with splits and a scored contract); the formulation is unchanged by this measurement and the recorded verdict stands. Cross-check against the publisher's own summary product done with a measured discrepancy recorded honestly (multas product distinct-AI ratios 1.02-1.20 pre-2020, 0.82-0.90 in the AIe era) - construction must define the population from the main table alone. Verdict: READY for construction handoff.
